cause.root_cause_summary: Operational readiness (S10) is a static property; the real test is whether applying it to an actual decision moment produces the correct outcome -- here, honestly finding nothing to execute rather than fabricating work.

lesson: The first real application of a "ready" system is the point where forcing a result becomes most tempting -- the correct discipline is to let a fresh, independent re-search determine the outcome, and accept NO_ACTION_REQUIRED as a fully valid, successful result when that is what the real data shows.
